offers_products.reason: Sells sterilizers, surgical tables, endoscope reprocessors, detergents, barrier products and other consumables.

offers_services.reason: Provides equipment maintenance, instrument repair, microbial reduction (contract sterilization), laboratory testing and outsourced reprocessing.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are hospitals, healthcare facilities, device and pharmaceutical manufacturers, not individuals or households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to hospitals, surgical centers, pharmaceutical and biotech firms and medical device manufacturers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Largest segments are consumables and services (maintenance, sterilization contracts) bought repeatedly; capital equipment is the smaller part.

cyclical_demand.reason: Infection prevention, sterilization and device reprocessing are essential, regulated healthcare needs; hospitals keep buying in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Most sales are consumables and recurring services; sterilizers and surgical tables are big-ticket but the smaller part.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue is mainly from manufactured products and facility-based sterilization services, not primarily staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are hospital systems, large pharmaceutical and medical device manufacturers, and government healthcare facilities.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs manufacturing plants and a network of contract sterilization facilities (gamma, e-beam, EO) needing ongoing capital investment.

notes: Mix of consumables, services and capital equipment across segments; segment weights come from general knowledge.
